My experience duplicates that of another claim shown on your BBB site TO A TEE.
Placed an order. Original receipt did not match claims of order.. challenged said fee, which was removed.
Placed order July 13, 2026.
Merchant provided tracking information only after I made third reach out
Tracking number into the states was Accurate
Tracking number provided within states was incorrect.
Provided a secondary tracking number which was also incorrect
Claims the tracking numbers belong to USPS
USPS local never was in possession of merchandise
Merchant continued daily argument items were received
Filed claim with PayPal. They received same argument from merchant and closed case without.
I paid shipping insurance for this transaction
Merchant says my claim is with shipper, but provides no assistance in filing claim
Merchant list, BBB accredited, now I find this is an accurate.
I ordered a bunch of shirts and never received them and tried to email them and it is a fake email
I ordered shirts from them never received tracking number says it was delivered and I never received it.

Ordered Akemi in May(3 months supply). They sent another 3 months worth in June and July, almost another 3 in August.  I only ordered in May. Called to cancel and get a refund. Took almost an hour to convince to stop the orders and they told me no refund, would give discount on further order. Tried EMAIL as well, they wont return EMAILS.
I placed my order via email and the seller sent me a link to access the books on line and that they would send the hard copies soon. I have not every received the actual books themselves.

I received a check said it’s not a check. It is an allocated lender. It was an attempt to look like a check. It said it’s not a check. It is a allocated lender. And it read. It was a letter to inform me about an important manner regarding the property at my address and it said I had seven days of receiving the notice and it was secured by our current lender, which is the Bank Of Marion and they had the right to revoke allocated waiver they said to call this one800 number and gave us a property code number and it did look like a check. I just said allocated waiver for $199.00 and then it said not all consumers have previous coverage not affiliated with the Bank Of Marion, but I had the Bank Of Marion all over it. I will send you a picture of it.  (We have had our property paid off for years. We have no mortgage) but it was through Bank of Marion. So somehow they knew that.

I rented a vehicle from enterprise while my car was being repaired.  I rented the vehicle from June 8th- 12th. When I returned the rental the car was signed off from any damage.  Then about 6 weeks later I received a letter demanding money for damage to the vehicle. I went over to enterprise in Galesburg, Il where I  rented the vehicle from. I was told that if the claim was under 1000 then they wouldn't presume it. I was given a claim number and phone number to contact the claims department.  When I called I was told there wasn't anything under my name or claim number. I thought that would be the end of it. This past Friday I received a text and phone number about the same claim number. I was told I did damage the car and now they say I damaged the carpet as well. I google this phone number 866-3004407. It states this is a scam claiming damage was done to a vehicle rented from enterprise.

I placed two orders with this website a week apart. First order #129375 was placed on 7/1/26 and I received an order conformation and transaction number 202607012244072534. The second order was placed on 7/7/26 order #129379. The amount for both purchases were charged on my visa gift card (reloadable card). I have never received the merchandise or any replies to my numerous emails and letters sent. This website has NO Phone number...? They have a service email but it does not work. Messages get timed out and not delivered? No way to contact them I even called the building they are located in and they could not connect me either...  I do believe I have been scammed out of $235...
I received a text claiming to be GMD management about my house going to auction soon.
wanted to help me claim 13 million insurance policy

The item was made in China and shipped from China to the USA to me. The item was said to have been made by Jason Maynard a wounded veteran in the commercial.

I ordered an item and I received an email stating that it had shipped the next day. After waiting for a month and a half, and not receiving my item, I emailed customer service. They provided me with a link to track the shipping of my order. I had been checking the shipping periodically, but one day, the link had been disabled. I knew something was wrong when the shipper kept having nothing but problems with delivery. I contacted customer service again when the link was disabled and asked for a refund. They told me they couldn’t give me a refund immediately since the package was still out for delivery, but they had elevated my request to the highest priority level.

Came across an ad for a neckline massager to do four different functions. Stating it would relieve dizziness intention in the neck. Receive device all it does is vibrate. This device is cheap and deceptive. When contacted by email they responded by saying they would give 50% refund. 10 emails later in correspondence nothing has transpired in the form of a refund. I don't know why they keep carrying on a conversation when they're not going to intentionally refund the money. Very deceptive company very .. dishonest company! Trying to protect others from making the same mistake by purchasing one of these from this dishonest company.
